subject: MAP: Aurora Health - Mutual Action Plan + pricing request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@aurorahealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft + next steps (Aurora Health)

Hi Chris / Maya -

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Aurora_MAP_v1.docx) that lays out milestones, owners, dependencies, and a target close date. Key highlights: 

- Target close: 2026-06-15 (goal driven by Q3 onboarding window)
- Core milestones: POC kickoff, security review (SOC2 evidence), procurement/PO, contract signature, production rollout
- Owners: Aurora product + security (you), Redwood AE (me) for technical kickoff, Redwood RevOps for procurement/pricing (cc: Ethan)
- Dependencies: SOC2 evidence delivery, procurement timeline, SSO integration scope

Ask: please review the attached MAP and confirm (a) owners for the Aurora side, and (b) whether the target close date aligns with your internal fiscal commitments.

I've also attached a pricing workbook (Aurora_pricing_model.xlsx) with the current quote. I noted on the sheet a request from you during the call for a discount/credit discussion tied to commit level. If you confirm target ARR/commit range I will escalate for exec pricing approval.

Next steps I propose: 
1) You review and send owner names by 2026-04-02
2) We lock in POC scope and dates in the MAP by 2026-04-09
3) Redwood to submit pricing/discount request for exec review by 2026-04-10

Thanks - I attached the SOC2 summary for your security team's quick reference.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.docx, Aurora_pricing_model.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

From: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps (Aurora Health)

Thanks Marissa - this looks good as a starting point. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Target close of 2026-06-15 is fine but procurement will probably need until mid-May for PO processing unless we run a faster approval path. Can we aim to have contract redlines by 2026-04-30?
- Security: our InfoSec wants the SOC2 evidence and a note on data residency (we're US-based only). SOC2 summary attached was helpful; can your team confirm data residency and retention controls?
- Pricing/discount: our execs are asking for preferential pricing if we commit to a 2-year deal at $300k ARR (we're targeting a multi-year commit). Specifically: 20% off list and $30k in implementation credits. If you can get that to pricing, we can push procurement to prioritize.

Also cc'ing our procurement lead (Maya) - she will start compiling the vendor packet.

Can you escalate the pricing ask? We need a preliminary answer to shape the internal decision.

- Chris Nguyen
Director of Product, Aurora Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Chris Nguyen <chris.nguyen@aurorahealth.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T13:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + pricing ask - Aurora Health (requesting exec pricing review)

Avery / Ethan / Laura -

Looping you in on Aurora Health (attached MAP + pricing workbook). They are asking for: 

- 20% off list pricing
- $30k implementation credits
- Commit: 2 years, target ARR $300k (they indicate they can commit at that level)
- Timeline: hoping contract redlines by 2026-04-30 and signature by ~2026-06-15

Why this matters: Aurora is a good-fit HS SaaS customer with clear production use case and HIPAA-adjacent data flows (US data residency required). If we can approve a commercial package with credits tied to a 2-year commit, procurement will prioritize and likely accelerate PO issuance.

Request: can RevOps / finance / sales leadership review and confirm whether we can support the 20% + $30k credits for a 2-year commit at $300k ARR? If you need formal rationale I can attach ARR build and adoption plan from the MAP.

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v1.docx, Aurora_pricing_model.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks - Marissa

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft + pricing ask - Aurora Health (rev ops input)

Thanks for the context. Quick RevOps read: 

- 20% discount on list for a $300k ARR, 2-year commit is within the typical range for strategic mid-market deals, but we need to ensure margin thresholds and discount bands.
- $30k implementation credit is doable if we tie credits to a minimum first-year usage commit and milestone-based deployment acceptance; propose credits be applied as services credits (one-time) rather than upfront rebate.
- I need clarity on net-new ARR attribution and whether there are any channel/marketplace fees (none indicated).

Requesting approval from Sales Leadership (Avery/Laura) on an exception to our standard discount band to approve 20% and the $30k credit. If approved, RevOps will prepare a conditional commercial term sheet and tracked credit schedule.

If leadership wants, I can prepare a one-pager showing P&L impact for the proposed commercial terms - ETA by EOD 2026-03-31.

Ethan Park
RevOps Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-31T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft + pricing ask - Aurora Health (approval)

Team - after a quick review with Laura, we can provisionally approve the requested commercial package subject to the following conditions: 

1) Commit: 2-year term at $300k ARR (must be contractually committed)
2) Discount: 20% off list is approved as an exception for this deal
3) Credits: $30k implementation credits approved, applied as milestone-based services credits (not cash)
4) Security: Redwood to confirm US-only data residency and provide SOC2 reports to Aurora security team before contract signature
5) Procurement timeline: RevOps to provide the conditional term sheet by 2026-04-02; legal to prepare a redline window to hit the 2026-04-30 internal target

Ethan - please prepare the P&L impact and the term sheet. Marissa - please confirm Aurora will sign a 2-year commitment and that procurement can aim for 2026-04-30 redlines. Once we have that confirmation, we will move to finalize.

Avery Johnson
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
